title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: When parents yell at the ref
hook: A parent is yelling at a teenage referee.
intro: A parent on your sideline is getting loud.
statement: Kids watch how the adults on their side behave.
q1: Do you step in and calm the parent right away —
q2: or set expectations before the season and remind as needed?
q3: Who is the referee, and how old are they?
t1: Both can work. But the sideline stays calmer
t2: when parents know the expectation ahead of time.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle it?
ctaLines: A word in the moment. A preseason talk. A team parent helps.
Step in or set it early?
ctaPrompt: Share your sideline habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent is yelling at a teenage referee.
The call was close. A parent on your sideline is getting loud.
Kids watch how the adults on their side behave.
Step in during the game or set expectations early. There is no single right way.
How do you handle it? Share your habit in the comments.
